notes: t006-t007 'It is' is the cleft dummy and its copula, one added unit headed on the copula under rule 20's cleft paragraph. The cleft's relative slot is filled by a 'that' a written לְ answers for, so only the dummy and copula are supplied.
Both לְ + infinitive phrases are recast as finite clauses and each preposition takes its complementizer 'that', the modal and supplied subject going to the infinitive (rules 48 and 52).
s006-s007 עַל דִּבְרַת → 'because of' fuses under rule 30, source head on the construct noun and target head on 'because' by rule 24's content-word test.
'themselves' is given to the second explicit pronoun הֵמָּה; the reflexive dative לָהֶם and its suffix are each unrepresented under rule 40, which covers a dative the ASV renders by nothing at all.
